descriptions.shortDescription: Provide digital services to the residents
descriptions.longDescription:
Using Open Inwoner platform administrators can easily fill in the information about municipality products and services with the convenient WYSIWYG editor. The users can search through the products with the power of the full-text search and the questionnaires to access the services which are applicable and useful in their situation.
The users can interact with each other and exchange messages and documents. The users can create plans together to achieve their goals.
The style of the application is easily configurable: all the colors, images, help texts and the logo can be set up and changed in the admin page.
Open Inwoner is developed in line with the Common Ground principles and provides integration with Common Ground services such as Open Zaak and Haal Centraal.
features: Interact with other users of the platform

metrics.name: Contributor Absence Factor
metrics.explanation: The fewest people who together made half of the commits on the default branch in the last 12 months, of the 100 contributors GitHub reports, among 8 human contributors. At 1 the project depends on a single person. Bots are left out; one person with several accounts or addresses counts more than once.

metrics.name: Organizational Diversity
metrics.explanation: Organisations are told apart by the email domain of the latest 300 commits of the last 12 months (286 commits by people, after the .mailmap) and, for a personal or hidden address, by the company on the author's public profile. The largest is maykinmedia.nl (7 authors), with 100% of the 262 commits whose organisation is known; 8% of the commits come from 1 of 8 authors whose organisation stays unknown. Only these counts are kept, no names, addresses or companies; an organisation is named only when several authors share it.
